additional_info.body:
Dear eMobility Technical Support Team,
We have been waiting for a long time for this issue to be resolved.
In the last email from Mr. Harun Ar Rashid dated 24 February 2026, it was clearly stated that the problem had been identified and that a regional technician would visit the site to resolve the issue. However, no action has been taken so far.
On 26 March 2026 (nearly one month later), we received an email from Mr. Syed Basheeruddin stating that the charger requires on-site maintenance and that a remote check is not possible. (please check attached Email)
Therefore, we kindly request clarification: has the issue already been identified, or is it not possible to perform a remote diagnosis?
We have faced significant issues with Mercedes Kuwait due to the considerable delay in technical support and maintenance, which is unacceptable.
We urgently request you to resolve this issue immediately and to provide a clear and realistic timeline for repair without any further delay.
Additionally, please note that we have already waited nearly one full year for the replacement screen to be delivered.
We look forward to your prompt response and immediate action.
Best Regards,
Mahmoud Ahmad
